philosophy: Make the next action and its result clear. State is stronger than decoration.
Preserve the supplied artwork, composition, geometry and real interactions. Design continuity is part of function.
Give every role a named owner. Components consume semantic aliases; copied literals do not become competing truths.
Keep the family through artwork, quiet depth, considered type and restrained signal. Adapt each product to its work and platform.
Keep one continuous native shell. Material supports the task; content does not paint a second window.
Motion explains place or state and yields to reduced motion. Text and keyboard operation remain readable and usable.
Record every exception, new rule and retirement in the same core. Evidence is searchable without being mistaken for an active default.

policy.generation: Edit the versioned core or profile source templates, generate exports, and check drift. Repositories carry pinned self-contained inputs; no sibling source paths are build dependencies.

website.use: Public website and product marketing chrome
website.theme: data-theme on html; system default; theme storage key
website.rule: Use --site-* roles and cream key CTAs. Product artifacts retain native geometry and interaction.

docs-reader.rule: Reader geometry and palette are independent of marketing chrome. Geist, Instrument Serif and Geist Mono.

web-admin.use: Staff administration, including Ant Design portals
web-admin.rule: Use AntD token and component adapters. Do not repair AntD density through generic shadcn input/table changes.

web-app.rule: Resolve the actual route provider. Workspace, Obsidian Glass and embedded portal styles coexist; do not apply all globally.

shared-web.rule: The shared package is not the universal website palette; preserve amber/telemetry semantics in its own consumers.
shared-web.consumerOwner: Same main repository, packages/ui and packages/tailwind-config

ouros-x.theme: Appearance, Glass/Matte material and rounded/squared shape are separate axes
ouros-x.rule: Current native source wins over copied Studio assets and old token-engine defaults. Preserve native contour and app-owned control geometry.

ouros-gpui.rule: Shared principles adapt through platform-native rendering. Do not import the OS theme into app chrome.
ouros-gpui.consumerEntry: Current theme/material source in native source manifest

native-shell-registry.use: Shared shell vocabulary and generated Studio/native exports
native-shell-registry.rule: Edit generation input rather than generated CSS/Rust/Swift. Registry is a source-backed contract, not proof every runtime matches it.

nativeShell.name: Ouros
principles: One continuous shell; content does not paint a second window.
Quiet depth and restrained highlights; state is clearer than decoration.
A compact 64-point rhythm scales into working surfaces without changing control density.
Platform-native type and material are adaptations, not competing identities.
Motion explains a change of place or state and disappears under Reduce Motion.

linux.material: GTK/Cairo tint plus compositor blur when available

web.mono: system monospace or bundled Workflow Mono
web.material: CSS reconstruction for authoring; native frame for final Mac pixels

termin8.use: Termin8 native terminal and command palette
termin8.rule: Keep terminal content, command palette and outer chrome roles distinct. Marketing donut composition is a separate surface.

fleet-console.use: Fleet Console native console and popover
fleet-console.rule: Preserve actual console columns, minimum sizes, popover measurements and native menu behavior.
fleet-console.consumerEntry: Native theme/console and popover source in source manifest

mandarin.use: Mandarin code editor and integrated Agent RX
mandarin.theme: Dark, light, rust camo and native material variants
mandarin.rule: Editor/syntax/status roles belong to Mandarin. Website body typography does not restyle the editor.

agent-rx.theme: Terminal palette variants and semantic ANSI roles
agent-rx.rule: Preserve exact terminal palette roles. Website character model is a separate authored artifact.

loop-builder.use: Loop Builder application and website embedding
loop-builder.theme: Carbon .cds--white / .cds--g100 plus scoped zones; IBM Plex and Carbon Sass roles
loop-builder.rule: Original app behavior and constellation artifact survive the shared marketing shell. Carbon Sass imports own theme, type and spacing; preserve those separately from website tokens.

loop-carbon-preset.use: Imported Carbon theme, type, layout and motion definitions
loop-carbon-preset.rule: Versioned dependency evidence. This is not proof of current main lockfile equivalence or approval of every upstream theme on every Ouros surface.

zilch.theme: Surface-specific website roles; CLI rendering if present
zilch.rule: No independently verified standalone global Zilch theme was found. Use website roles for its site; no invented native palette.
zilch.consumerOwner: Website main apps/site; Zilch command package embedded in Agent RX
zilch.consumerEntry: Current Zilch product source and RX package source

os-theme.use: Omarchy desktop and terminal skin only
os-theme.theme: Core intro colors; ANSI extension is a proposal
os-theme.rule: Keep red/black OS skin out of product/web defaults; retain asset-rights restrictions.

osTheme.title: Ouros OS/terminal theme (Omarchy desktop skin)

meta.whenToUse: Desktop/terminal theming only: Omarchy window manager, kitty/waybar colors, wallpapers, intro video/audio, dragon sprites, greeter/splash/lock-screen art. Not a product or web UI palette.
meta.authority: Core colors match the approved intro film exactly. The extended ANSI set is a readable-terminal proposal layered on top, not an existing official Omarchy theme.
meta.notAnOfficialTheme: Derived from the Omarchy wordmark / Delta Corps Priest 1 lettering; not an official Omarchy theme.

usage.note: Keep most UI neutral so the dragon stays the focal point. Test readability before placing text over the noisy wallpaper texture.

display-font.usage: Display lettering only, not a terminal body-text font. Community Omarchy Font by Mark Cuda, MIT license (see fonts/LICENSE.txt).

rights.audioAndVideo: The audio was supplied by the project owner for transfer to their own device(s). That does NOT establish rights to publish or redistribute it. Clear audio rights before publishing any public theme or video containing it (applies to audio-intro-full, audio-final-cut, and intro-video-1080p, which carries the audio track).

doNot: Do not treat this as an official Omarchy theme.
Do not publish or redistribute the intro audio/video assets without clearing rights first (see rights.audioAndVideo).
Do not use this palette on product or marketing web surfaces.

historical.use: Prior registry, flyers, design studies and reference exports
historical.rule: Searchable evidence only. Retired paths, black-on-orange labels and obsolete navigation are not active defaults.

fleet-terminal.use: Fleet terminal/GPUI integration palette, distinct from native AppKit

linux-launcher.use: Actual GTK native launcher on Omarchy
linux-launcher.rule: Preserve actual GTK renderer, appearance choices, existing runtime identity and blur-safety behavior.

ouros-gpui-v2.use: Actual installed Ouros GPUI v2 application
ouros-gpui-v2.rule: Preserve installed v2 renderer, interaction and geometry; standalone GPUI remains a separate replacement profile.

web-auth.use: Actual customer sign-in and recovery gateway presentation
web-auth.rule: Preserve existing forms, endpoints, cream keys, supplied artwork and NoiseField. Compile shared core into the existing customer-auth stylesheet; no additional request.

studio-portal.use: Private owner Studio portal and native editor semantic adapters
studio-portal.rule: Keep portal controls scoped, preserve native editor geometry and original projects. Generated action fill/foreground remain opaque in all states; native editor mint palette remains distinct.

web-product-demos.use: Source-authored embedded Loop and document demo artifacts
web-product-demos.rule: Keep the original scoped demo palette, typography, geometry and interactions; its warm decorative accent is separate from shared filled controls.

navigation.composition: retained floating tray with original mobile circles; replaces rejected full-width bar

logo-wordmark-white.usage: Selected original artwork; preserve shape, proportions and transparency.

logo-globe-star.usage: Selected original artwork; preserve shape, proportions and transparency.
